text:
recipe: sweet chili chicken with
coconut lime drizzle
*
SERVINGS PREP TIME COOK TIME
4 45 min 15 min
o QUICK & EASY o SLOW COOKER o ONE POT/PAN o KID CHEF FRIENDLY o EVERYDAY
o MAKE AHEAD o PRESSURE COOKER o AIR FRYER X FAMILY FAVORITE o SPECIAL OCCASION
o VEG o VEGAN o GLUTEN FREE o DAIRY FREE o NUT FREE o KOSHER
INGREDIENTS
marinade
2 lbs chicken thighs
1/3c sweet chili sauce
2 TB soy sauce
1 TB sesame oil
2 garlic cloves (minced)
1tsp grated fresh ginger
1 TB lime juice

coconut lime drizzle
1/2 c canned coconut milk
2 TB mayo
1 TB lime juice
1 tsp lime zest
1 TB sriracha
pinch of salt

2c cooked rice
DIRECTIONS
▷marinate chicken at least 30 min
▷ make coconut lime drizzle
- whisk together coconut milk, mayo, lime juice,
lime zest, sriracha, and a pinch of salt
▷cook chicken
- heat grill pan over medium high heat
-lightly oil the surface
- grill marinated chicken 5-7 min per side
-let rest 5 min before slicing
▷ assemble the bowls
- top rice with chicken
- drizzle with coconut lime drizzle
- garnish with lime wedges

text:
Lemon Garlic Pasta
Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 1 hr 5 mins
Servings: 6

Ingredients
For the pasta:
• 1 lb spaghetti
• 2 tablespoons olive oil
For the sauce:
• 4 cloves garlic, minced
• ½ cup grated parmesan
• salt and pepper to taste

Instructions
1. Boil the pasta in salted water.
2. Warm the oil and garlic in a pan,
then toss in the pasta.
3. Stir in the parmesan.

Notes
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

Grandma's Biscuits
2 c flour
1 TB baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
6 TB cold butter
3/4 c milk
Mix the dry ingredients.
Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the milk and bake at 450 for 12 minutes.
